_about: F17: Central Water Commission (CWC) level-forecast stations used where INDOFLOODS has no gauge within 30 km. Levels are copied from the official CWC Daily Flood Bulletin named in source_url (warning / danger / highest flood level as printed there). Station coordinates are from Google Flood Hub's page for the same CWC station id (location_source). Cities with no entry stay rainfall-driven.

guwahati.source: CWC Daily Flood Bulletin 17/07/2019, Part I-B (Central Flood Control Room, New Delhi)

patna.source: CWC Daily Flood Bulletin 01/10/2019, Part I-B (Central Flood Control Room, New Delhi)

_none_found.mumbai: No CWC level-forecast station in or near Mumbai in the CWC daily flood bulletins checked (08/07, 14-17/07, 30/09, 01/10/2019); stays rainfall-driven.
_none_found.chennai: No CWC level-forecast station in or near Chennai in the CWC daily flood bulletins checked; stays rainfall-driven.
_none_found.kolkata: The nearest CWC level-forecast site in the bulletins checked is Farakka (Ganga), far more than 30 km away; the Hooghly at Kolkata is tidal and has no CWC level-forecast entry there. Stays rainfall-driven.
